english.note: Use X光 as the all-purpose term for X-ray radiation itself, rather than X光片 or X光機.

examples.english: The doctor said this examination uses X-ray to see the bones clearly.
examples.traditional: 醫生話呢種檢查會用X光睇清楚骨頭。
